questions.stem: Methane has an energy content of 56 kJ/g and ethanol has an energy content of 30 kJ/g. What does this comparison tell us?

options.text: Methane and ethanol release the same amount of energy
Methane releases almost twice as much energy per gram as ethanol
Ethanol releases more total energy per mole than methane
Ethanol is a better fuel because it has a lower energy content

questions.explanation: Comparing energy per gram, methane (56 kJ/g) releases almost twice as much energy as ethanol (30 kJ/g). This means you would need roughly twice the mass of ethanol to get the same energy output as methane. Energy per gram is an important factor when comparing fuels.
